spans.s: + उन्नयन सीमन्त- + उन्नयन, n. (arranging of the hair) a purificatory and sacrificial ceremony observed by women in the sixth or eighth month of their first pregnancy.
+ विवाद सीमा- + विवाद, m. a litigation respecting boundaries,
Man. 8, 6
and वी शिम्बी, f. A legume, a pod,
Mālat. 145, 20
सिम (akin to सम), adj. Every, all, entire.
सीमा, see सीमन्.
सिम्भ्, see सृम्भ्.

सीमन्, i. e. सि or सिव् + मन्, and सीमा सीमा, f.
 1. A boundary, Böhtl. Ind.
Spr. 461
; a limit, a landmark,
; 255; Pañc. i. d. 104 (मन् and मा); skirt, Utt.
Rāmac. 43, 6

(मन्).
 2. Observance of due bounds in morals, Bhaṭṭ. 1, 6;

Nalod. 3, 28.
 3

. A field.
 4. The nape of the neck.
 5. The scrotum.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. ἵμας; O.S. sîmo, laqueus.

सीमन्त, i. e. *सीमन्त्, the original form of सीमन्, + अ,
 I. m. A separation of the hair on each side, so as to leave a distinct line on the top of the head,
Megh. 66

.
 II. m. and n. The head.
 III. m. or n. A landmark (?),
Lass. 41, 7
सीमन्तित, i. e. ptcple. pf. pass. of a denomin. सीमन्तय, derived from सीमन्त, Marked by a line,
सीमन्तिनी, i. e. सीमन्त + इन् + ई, f. A woman, Hit. ii. d. 6.
